interpretation: Every behavioural/economic result is simulation-relative; no real commercial claim.
30 fixed-world repeated-data datasets per probe; Wilson intervals reflect finite seed count, not nominal coverage guarantees.
Beta targets cohort-average probability; Laplace targets full visible-context probability. This is not simulation-based calibration.
Policies and priors were frozen before sealed-test scoring. Evaluator conditional probabilities never fit or choose a model.
Primary sealed-test scores use 900 fresh confirmation applicants from fixed seed 20261110, separate from earlier implementation checks; no benchmark seeds were selected for a winner.
Policy-value intervals are paired applicant bootstraps after freeze, not posterior intervals.
All applicants, including manual reviews at -€15, remain in the denominator.
Segment-specific marginal training ranges and same-cell counts are heuristic support diagnostics, not a calibrated out-of-distribution detector.
